title: I built an iOS app to cut through SEC filing and earnings-event noise—looking for trader feedback
author: catalyst-radar
selftext:
I built Catalyst Radar for traders who follow specific tickers but don't want to sort through every routine filing or a generic earnings calendar.

You choose the tickers you follow. The app monitors SEC filings and earnings events, then surfaces potentially meaningful catalysts with short summaries,  
filing details, and links back to the original SEC source.

It's live on the App Store now, and I'm doing a small soft launch. I'd especially value feedback from people who already track filings or earnings as part of their trading workflow:

\- Is the information useful when you're checking a ticker?  
\- What feels noisy, missing, or confusing?  
\- Does the initial setup make sense?

There's a 15-day free trial; continued access after that requires a paid subscription through the App Store. I'm the developer, and candid criticism is welcome.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/catalyst-radar/id6804079486

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: the filter is the whole product here. if it can tell an 8-K with item 5.02 (an officer leaving) apart from a routine 9.01 exhibit filing, that alone beats most earnings calendars. clustered Form 4 buys would be the next thing I'd want flagged.

replies.author: catalyst-radar
replies.body: Noted, we can definitely look into adding that. Thanks for the input

replies.author: catalyst-radar
replies.body: I’ve run your comment past the team and we’ve decided to add these 2 items to the next release. It may not be immediate but it’ll be there. Thank you for the input. Hopefully we can get a perfect Tier 1 app before we add the Tier 2 upgrades

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: good. the 5.02 one alone will earn its keep, most of the noise in 8-Ks is exhibits nobody needs a push for.
